families.title: Surface
families.verdict: retain the graphic engine; redesign composition and movement

families.title: Sculpture
families.verdict: retain the 3D foundation; rebuild motion direction and framing
families.scope: M; optional growth solver is L

families.title: Fractals
families.verdict: separate 2D ornament from 3D environment; retain the mathematics
families.scope: M for 2D direction; L for world traversal

families.title: Oil Slides
families.verdict: retain the optical pass; replace the repeated behavioral setup
families.scope: L for a convincing liquid instrument

families.title: Super 8 Paint
families.verdict: retain film transport; redesign marks and temporal composition
families.scope: M; original scanned media is an optional addition

families.title: Graphic Patterns
families.verdict: retain layout/rendering; replace synchronized motion with designed relationships
families.scope: M — high return with limited renderer risk

families.title: Image / imported media
families.verdict: retain still compositing; extend it into a deliberate source/input workflow
families.scope: M for field inputs; L for moving-media ingest

families.title: Caustic Atlas
families.verdict: replace the line-threshold look with a receiver-based light construction

families.title: Living Ink
families.verdict: separate reaction patterns from ink transport; rebuild the evolving treatment

families.title: Magnetic Skin
families.verdict: replace the peak geometry model; retain a legacy cellular-metal mode

families.title: Velvet Currents
families.verdict: retain deterministic path reconstruction; rebuild emission, density and ribbon form
families.scope: M/L — path composition and renderer work

families.title: Kinetic Relief
families.verdict: retain actual solids; replace the square-grid choreography
families.scope: M — scene, layout and event design

families.title: Holographic Loom
families.verdict: replace the flat plaid construction with a deforming material surface
families.scope: L for cloth; M for an authored procedural surface

families.title: Crystal Reef
families.verdict: separate the polygon mosaic from an actual clustered growth instrument
families.scope: L — topology, geometry and growth authoring

families.title: Prism Cathedral
families.verdict: replace nested 2D outlines with a coherent optical space
families.scope: L — 3D scene and optics; bounded quality first

families.title: Resonant Sand
families.verdict: retain the nodal field; add actual grain organization and mode events
families.scope: M/L — particle response and temporal direction

families.title: Volumetric Veils
families.verdict: retain ray integration; rebuild density structure and scene lighting
families.scope: L for a convincing atmosphere; M for bounded procedural veils

interconnection.title: Limelight — Interconnection
interconnection.lesson: Bucharest 2016: architectural features participate in the image. Region relationships matter more than adding surface noise.
interconnection.evidence: Primary page / author description; linked films are not fully timecoded in this audit.

superreal.title: Moment Factory — SuperReal
superreal.lesson: Immersive scene direction and contrasting spatial worlds; a whole installation is a larger problem than a material generator.
superreal.evidence: Primary page / author description; linked films are not fully timecoded in this audit.

aura.title: Moment Factory / Notch — AURA Invalides
aura.lesson: Documented combination of Notch particles and lighting with Cinema 4D, Unreal and After Effects; onsite iteration via NDI. Supports a hybrid pipeline, not a claim that one shader produced the show.
aura.evidence: Primary page / author description; linked films are not fully timecoded in this audit.

waterparticles.title: teamLab — Universe of Water Particles
waterparticles.lesson: 3D water trajectories become drawn lines. This is a motion and spatial organization reference, not evidence that our analytic flow is equivalent.
waterparticles.evidence: Primary page / author description; linked films are not fully timecoded in this audit.

livingmural.title: Universal Everything — Living Mural
livingmural.lesson: Architecture and hand-drawn animation organized around distinct actions such as burst, fill, chase and multiply.
livingmural.evidence: Primary page / author description; linked films are not fully timecoded in this audit.

box.title: Bot & Dolly — Box, Ian Sherman production account
box.lesson: A participant documents virtual camera, forced perspective, synchronization and TouchDesigner compositing. Coherent scene design is essential; our app has no robotics or calibration.
box.evidence: Primary page / author description; linked films are not fully timecoded in this audit.

lyrique.title: 1024 architecture — Perspective Lyrique
lyrique.lesson: Voice level drives deformation of recognizable architecture. A directed cause produces a specific spatial response.
lyrique.evidence: Primary page / author description; linked films are not fully timecoded in this audit.

fuji.title: Studio Lemercier — FUJI
fuji.lesson: Drawing, projection and sound create a narrative with limited light. Restraint and underlying surface imagery deserve equal attention to detail density.
fuji.evidence: Primary page / author description; linked films are not fully timecoded in this audit.

strata.title: Quayola — Strata #1
strata.lesson: Computational abstraction derives composition and color from the original fresco; relevant to image-guided generation.
strata.evidence: Primary page / author description; linked films are not fully timecoded in this audit.

kodama.title: Sachiko Kodama + Minako Takeno — Protrude, Flow
kodama.lesson: Physical ferrofluid provides a material reference, not a digital effect to copy.
kodama.evidence: Primary page / author description; linked films are not fully timecoded in this audit.

kodamatech.title: Kodama — Protrude, Flow project account
kodamatech.lesson: Explains sound-controlled physical magnetic fluid, pointed peaks and flowing transformations.
kodamatech.evidence: Primary page / author description; linked films are not fully timecoded in this audit.

fidenza.title: Tyler Hobbs — Fidenza algorithm account
fidenza.lesson: Non-overlap, varied widths, margins and weighted palettes organize flow fields. Static generative composition reference, not a motion reference.
fidenza.evidence: Primary page / author description; linked films are not fully timecoded in this audit.

flora.title: Nervous System — Floraform
flora.lesson: Differential growth changes elastic surface form. Relevant to believable folded sculpture; not crystal physics.
flora.evidence: Primary page / author description; linked films are not fully timecoded in this audit.

joshua.title: Joshua Light Show — Present
joshua.lesson: Physical liquid projection, improvisation and mixed analog/digital construction. Oil reference; not a prescribed simulator.
joshua.evidence: Primary page / author description; linked films are not fully timecoded in this audit.

mclaren.title: NFB — Begone Dull Care, McLaren and Lambart
mclaren.lesson: Painting and engraving directly on film, rhythm and gesture. A direct-film reference, not Super 8 capture.
mclaren.evidence: Primary page / author description; linked films are not fully timecoded in this audit.

mclarennotes.title: NFB — McLaren technical notes
mclarennotes.lesson: Direct-film production and phrase-based making; different textures have different physical causes. Historical process document.
mclarennotes.evidence: Primary archive PDF, relevant technical passages; not an exhaustive reading of every film entry.

lye.title: Ngā Taonga — A Colour Box, Len Lye
lye.lesson: Painted celluloid and rhythmic design; useful reference for expressive marks, not a source asset library.
lye.evidence: Primary page / author description; linked films are not fully timecoded in this audit.

BoxMappingToolkit.title: DJVB — BoxMappingToolkit
BoxMappingToolkit.lesson: Depth, internal mechanisms, face continuity and black space give a cube a coherent illusion.
BoxMappingToolkit.evidence: Primary product page and browser-observed trailer/preview samples; not the complete pack or an annotated full viewing.

FluidMandalas.title: Matthias Müller — FluidMandalas
FluidMandalas.lesson: Dense fluid/particle forms have bodies, wisps and several scales; do not copy the bright trailer treatment indiscriminately.
FluidMandalas.evidence: Primary product page and browser-observed trailer/preview samples; not the complete pack or an annotated full viewing.

FerroCious.title: HybridVisuals — FerroCious
FerroCious.lesson: Physical ferrofluid footage is a useful counterexample to smooth shaded cells.
FerroCious.evidence: Primary product page and browser-observed trailer/preview samples; not the complete pack or an annotated full viewing.

BlueSpace.title: Julius Horsthuis — BlueSpace
BlueSpace.lesson: Fractal structures can be staged as environments with depth hierarchy rather than isolated thumbnails.
BlueSpace.evidence: Primary product page and browser-observed trailer/preview samples; not the complete pack or an annotated full viewing.

DeepSilk2.title: RAW Designs — DeepSilk2
DeepSilk2.lesson: Large folds, silhouette, reflection cards and quiet regions contribute more fabric presence than a tiny thread grid.
DeepSilk2.evidence: Primary product page and browser-observed trailer/preview samples; not the complete pack or an annotated full viewing.

FeedboxAbstract.title: Dan Chelger — FeedboxAbstract
FeedboxAbstract.lesson: Artist-programmed feedback modeled after analog equipment; feedback is a system with memory.
FeedboxAbstract.evidence: Primary product page and creator/retailer description; pack not purchased or executed.

ConsciousCoral.title: Julius Horsthuis — ConsciousCoral
ConsciousCoral.lesson: Day/night treatments offer a concrete lesson in lighting the same kind of form differently.
ConsciousCoral.evidence: Primary product page and creator/retailer description; pack not purchased or executed.

FogAndDust.title: Tristan Gieler — FogAndDust
FogAndDust.lesson: Atmosphere belongs in a scene with depth references; not just a fullscreen density texture.
FogAndDust.evidence: Primary product page and creator/retailer description; pack not purchased or executed.

AchromaticHiss.title: KRATATA — AchromaticHiss
AchromaticHiss.lesson: Minimal patterned forms can carry the image through scale, overlap, rhythm and negative space.
AchromaticHiss.evidence: Primary product page and browser-observed trailer/preview samples; not the complete pack or an annotated full viewing.

ParticleParty.title: Visual Lab — ParticleParty
ParticleParty.lesson: Current market reference for discrete 3D particle bodies; do not infer the production algorithm from its marketing text.
ParticleParty.evidence: Primary product page and creator/retailer description; pack not purchased or executed.

InternalCircuitry.title: Visual Lab — InternalCircuitry
InternalCircuitry.lesson: Current market reference for deliberate graphic rhythm and impact.
InternalCircuitry.evidence: Primary product page and creator/retailer description; pack not purchased or executed.

tdnoise.title: TouchDesigner — Noise TOP
tdnoise.lesson: Noise families and explicit coordinate input. Noise and domain construction can be varied separately.
tdnoise.evidence: Official operator documentation, relevant summary and parameters.

tdparticle.title: TouchDesigner — Particle POP
tdparticle.lesson: Per-point state, birth, death, forces and feedback; compare actual particle behavior rather than a texture called particles.

tdfeedback.title: TouchDesigner — Feedback TOP
tdfeedback.lesson: Explicit downstream target and reset behavior. Stateful feedback differs from a bounded analytic echo.
tdfeedback.evidence: Official operator documentation, summary and reset parameters.

tddisplace.title: TouchDesigner — Displace TOP
tddisplace.lesson: An image/field drives spatial displacement; a different operation from advection or physical fluid simulation.
tddisplace.evidence: Official operator documentation, summary and channel behavior.

tdpbr.title: TouchDesigner — PBR MAT
tdpbr.lesson: Geometry, lighting and maps cooperate; PBR controls alone do not author a convincing material.
tdpbr.evidence: Official operator documentation, summary and material parameters.

tdinstance.title: TouchDesigner curriculum — Basics of Instancing
tdinstance.lesson: Instances can have individually sourced translation, rotation, scale, color and texture attributes.

tddrip.title: Crystal Jow / IIHQ — Jen Stark-inspired colour drip
tddrip.lesson: A concrete feedback/displacement comparison for Surface. Study the motion mechanism without reproducing an artist’s signature composition.
tddrip.evidence: Author tutorial description hosted by Derivative; network not executed.

tdpaint.title: Crystal Jow / IIHQ — Painterly Feedback
tdpaint.lesson: Specific painterly feedback reference for Super 8 Paint and image-driven effects.
tdpaint.evidence: Author tutorial description; network not executed.

tdanalog.title: Crystal Jow / IIHQ — Audio Reactive Analog Content
tdanalog.lesson: Prepare analog assets, animate them and mix them with digital content; the materials themselves need variation.
tdanalog.evidence: Author tutorial description; linked work not fully viewed.

tdrd.title: Pao Olea — Reaction Diffusion 19.01
tdrd.lesson: Published chapter breakdown covers diffusion, displacement, feedback, color and resolution; treat it as an authored workflow, not a single magic TOP.
tdrd.evidence: Creator video description/chapter list; not a watched full-video claim.

tdaura.title: Pao Olea — Aura Flow [34]
tdaura.lesson: October 2026: trail form, per-point color, material, lights and a separate detail layer. Direct comparison for Currents.
tdaura.evidence: Author tutorial page; network not executed.

tdplants.title: Pao Olea — Creating Plants [35]
tdplants.lesson: November 2026: POP attributes and trail construction. Current growth vocabulary, without assuming it simulates mineral growth.
tdplants.evidence: Author tutorial page; network not executed.

tdwhitney.title: Pao Olea — Instancing Sine Cos [33]
tdwhitney.lesson: October 2026: John Whitney-inspired instancing. Sine motion can be excellent when spatial relationships are designed.
tdwhitney.evidence: Author tutorial page; network not executed.

tdtiles.title: vtln — Rolling Tiles
tdtiles.lesson: October 2026: looping rows and columns, relevant to staged kinetic panels.
tdtiles.evidence: Author tutorial description; network not executed.

tdflip.title: Dean Cheesman — Flip-Dot Display
tdflip.lesson: Grid, sampled image attributes and feedback make geometry carry information.
tdflip.evidence: Author tutorial description; network not executed.

tdcloth.title: tormozgh — Fabric Simulation with Spring SOP
tdcloth.lesson: A deforming surface plus a silk treatment, a closer cloth construction benchmark than a displaced plaid.
tdcloth.evidence: Author tutorial description; example not executed.

tdcrystal.title: Pao Olea — Crystal Material [04]
tdcrystal.lesson: 3D base, PBR material, lighting, texture and shape refinement.
tdcrystal.evidence: Author tutorial description; example not executed.

tdglass.title: IIHQ — 3D Stained Glass
tdglass.lesson: HDRI and PBR give glass geometry a scene to respond to.
tdglass.evidence: Author tutorial description; example not executed.

tdwave.title: Aristides.Lab — WaveField TOX
tdwave.lesson: Wave equations operate on point/mesh sources and optional instances; includes Chladni modes. It is not evidence of a physical granular solver.
tdwave.evidence: Detailed author component description read; asset not executed.

tdvolume.title: NODE / Derivative — 3D Volumetrics in TouchDesigner
tdvolume.lesson: Raymarched volume shares a scene’s lighting calculations and provides spatial depth cues.
tdvolume.evidence: Creator course description; paid content not accessed.

raytk.title: tekt — RayTK volumetric sampling
raytk.lesson: SDF/fields, reflection and volume workflows; spatial composition can be modular.
raytk.evidence: Author tutorial/release description, historical version; not current release documentation.

tdchaser.title: reflekkt — Chaser mapping tutorial
tdchaser.lesson: Separate surface regions and sequence highlights. A simple, material-independent mapping behavior.

mmguide.title: MadMapper — custom GLSL materials
mmguide.lesson: Materials, typed inputs, direct surface rendering and optional render-to-texture.

mmlibrary.title: MadMapper — online material library
mmlibrary.lesson: Built-in versus installed community materials must be distinguished.
mmlibrary.evidence: Current official documentation; no popularity or performance ranking inferred.

mmspec.title: MadMapper — material extension specification
mmspec.lesson: MadMapper materials are related to ISF but have host extensions; render-to-texture can expose last-frame state.
mmspec.evidence: Official source specification; compatibility requires testing.

wire.title: Resolume — Wire
wire.lesson: A smaller content-focused node ecosystem; slices, FFT, OSC, Syphon/Spout and ISF are separate capabilities.
wire.evidence: Official support index, not an executed integration.

caustictech.title: Maxime Heckel — Caustics in WebGL
caustictech.lesson: Refracted rays and receiver mapping, with explicitly approximate real-time methods.
caustictech.evidence: Author technical article with implementation explanations.

evan.title: Evan Wallace — WebGL Water
evan.lesson: Heightfield waves, reflections/refractions, shadows and caustics are coupled.
evan.evidence: Original demo feature description; not benchmarked on this app’s GPU.

curl.title: Bridson, Hourihan & Nordenstam — Curl-Noise
curl.lesson: Procedural incompressible noise and boundary modulation; useful without a full fluid solver.
curl.evidence: Primary research paper, relevant method and limitations.

sims.title: Karl Sims — Reaction-Diffusion
sims.lesson: Feed/kill regimes, anisotropic diffusion, spatial style maps and the distinction between chemistry and display.

xpbd.title: Macklin, Müller & Chentanez — XPBD
xpbd.lesson: Compliance for constrained deformation; possible cloth route, not a guarantee of seamless loops or self-collision.

filament.title: Google — Physically Based Rendering in Filament
filament.lesson: Separated material/lighting models including cloth and anisotropy. Avoid reusing one coat for every medium.
filament.evidence: Primary renderer documentation; model principles, not a proposal to replace Three.js.

pbrt.title: PBRT — Volume Transmittance
pbrt.lesson: Light attenuation belongs along both view and light paths.

colonize.title: Runions, Lane & Prusinkiewicz — Space Colonization
colonize.lesson: A branching skeleton can respond to available space. Useful stylized growth mechanism, not mineral physics.
colonize.evidence: Primary paper abstract and algorithm excerpts.

physarum.title: Jeff Jones — Physarum transport networks
physarum.lesson: Agent/trail feedback is an alternate emergent network mechanism; research option for Ink/Reef, not mandatory scope.
physarum.evidence: Author institutional repository abstract; not an implemented solver.
